notes: Each case is a semantic target, NOT executable .atto source or a proof of backend support.
Backend teams must add checked .atto fixtures and executed compiler/guest evidence before changing the status.
Some dependent syntax/contracts remain open draft PRs; do not accept a compiler hack as normative behavior.

cases.name: scalar-int-inline
cases.requirement: int scalar remains i64 value in locals, inline fields and returns, no auto-boxing

cases.name: scalar-bool-memory
cases.requirement: byte-addressable bool memory accepts only canonical 0/1 and round-trips; SSA may be i1

cases.name: float-binary64
cases.requirement: float is binary64; parity includes signed zero, infinity and NaN handling per numeric semantics

cases.name: nested-inline-nominal-struct
cases.requirement: nominal Struct can be embedded in another aggregate; nested field offsets and drop glue checked

cases.name: struct-with-owned-reference-bitcopy
cases.requirement: raw memcpy-style duplication of owned ref-bearing Struct fails ownership check

cases.name: nominal-struct-shape-collision
cases.requirement: two distinct nominal Struct declarations with identical fields cannot be silently unified

cases.name: closed-record-shape-canonical
cases.requirement: closed Record shape independent of textual field ordering; source expressions evaluate once in source order

cases.name: open-record-missing-field
cases.requirement: open Record absent field must be guarded/reported rather than arbitrary slot read

cases.name: identity-class-distinct
cases.requirement: two separately allocated identity-class objects with equal fields have distinct logical identity

cases.name: identity-survives-stack-promotion
cases.requirement: scalar replacement/escape optimization does not change observable class identity

cases.name: value-class-no-identity
cases.requirement: identity comparison on identity-free value class is rejected by future equality contract

cases.name: inherited-field-alias-storage
cases.requirement: use Base.field as alias addresses same inherited field, never duplicate storage

cases.name: nonprimitive-default-read-loan
cases.requirement: ordinary Foo argument produces checked non-owning read loan; caller owner remains live

cases.name: nonprimitive-write-needs-mut
cases.requirement: mutating callee through ordinary read loan fails before guest artifact

cases.name: mutable-loan-exclusive
cases.requirement: conflicting shared/exclusive aliases fail, including second argument evaluation

cases.name: explicit-take-invalidates-source
cases.requirement: take! into a consuming parameter moves logical ownership and prevents subsequent sender use

cases.name: shallow-copy-unique-alias
cases.requirement: copy! must reject nested mutable ownership aliases without share proof

cases.name: deep-copy-graph-isolation
cases.requirement: copy!! yields independent nested mutable graph while preserving internal aliasing and cycles

cases.name: same-actor-ref32-stale-reuse
cases.requirement: stale Ref32 cannot become valid after free/reallocation or generation exhaustion

cases.name: actor-restart-ref32-replay
cases.requirement: old actor incarnation token cannot resolve to restarted actor's object

cases.name: cross-actor-raw-pointer-send
cases.requirement: raw Offset32/native pointer/Java MemorySegment may not be transported as an ActorRef or message

cases.name: failed-send-preserves-ownership
cases.requirement: mailbox rejection rolls back transfer/clone admission; sender retains ownership

cases.name: borrow-escape-suspension
cases.requirement: unpinned loan or critical-write guard may not survive await/select

cases.name: foreign-pointer-escape
cases.requirement: FFI cannot retain actor raw storage address beyond checked lifetime/capability

cases.name: stop-quiescence
cases.requirement: after STOP quiescence, actor drops once and every stale handle rejects

cases.name: java-guest-object-arena
cases.requirement: compiled Java guest object graph uses actor off-heap arena; report host allocations and GC honestly

cases.name: llvm-nontracing-guest-heap
cases.requirement: compiled LLVM guest object storage/drop has no guest tracing collector dependency

cases.name: object-graph-semantic-parity
cases.requirement: Java and LLVM compiled guests agree on field values, identity, loan, drop and copy outcomes

cases.name: actor-ref-capability-not-address
cases.requirement: ActorRef capability cannot be pointer-cast or dereferenced as class memory

cases.name: array-struct-soa-no-alias
cases.requirement: layout=soa Array<Struct> retains nominal types, checked layout and nested ownership rules
